outcome: Accuracy of ultrasound in diagnosing SGA
Neonatal complications (neonatal death, respiratory dysfunction, cardiovascular dysfunction, admission to NICU)
cohort: 146 patients prenatally suspected of having SGA pregnancies
finding: Serious neonatal complications were significantly more common in confirmed SGA cases.
mod_finding: Expectant management was more often associated with neonatal death and NICU admission compared to elective procedures.
birth_weight: Birth weight in the 10th percentile or below
